name: K I C Metaliks Limited
about: K I C Metaliks Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of pig iron in India. It offers pig iron, pig iron scraps, and its by-products. The company also provides coking coal, and other products. It supplies its products to foundries, automotive, and construction industries. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India. K I C Metaliks Limited operates as a subsidiary of Karni Syntex Pvt. Ltd.
